$comment: Every number PayStage publishes, with the population it describes and the command that reproduces it. Enforced by scripts/check-claims.mjs: an entry older than refresh_days fails; a numeric leaf rendered by a declared surface with no entry here fails; and a 3+ digit number in a table cell or bold span in docs/*.md with no entry here fails too (years, HTTP status codes, row/line references and hex/addresses are allowlisted). `source` paths under /work/ops are not in a clean checkout; those entries are freshness-checked only. Values are copied from the named source files, never typed from memory.
decision: Extend scripts/check-claims.mjs; do not add a second checker. check-claims is already the one place a published number is policed, it already runs in ci.yml and ci-local, and the #388 kill criterion said to extend it if it fits. A second ledger would be two places for the same fact to drift.
